column4: dialect-gated: cleat#2239's two isolation-specific race legs, added alongside the three registeredBackends legs (postgres/mysql/mssql at default isolation) to match cleat-review's finding that the FK-violation classifiers only fire at the docs-recommended isolation level (READ-COMMITTED for MySQL, RCSI on for SQL Server), not at each dialect's default. mysqlReadCommittedTestDB and mssqlPrivateRCSIConnStr each skip when their own DSN (CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL / CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL) is unset. This job sets only CLEAT_TEST_DB (Postgres), so both skip every run.
